title: Utility Tower Easement Dispute: Washington couple sue OPALCO over taller tower; case tests upgrade rights
summary_full: Liz Covert and Denis Goudie are taking a stand against the Orcas Power and Light Cooperative’s recent installation of a steel tower on their property. They claim that the easement permits only minor landscaping and not major installations. Furthermore, they contend that they received no prior notification regarding the construction set in motion in 2023.
